short_description: Only two games have ever scored 99 on Metacritic: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998) and GTA 6 (Nov 2026). GTA 6 also beat every Rockstar game before it: GTA IV 98, GTA V 97, Red Dead Redemption 2 97 (Metascores). Bars start at 90 so the differences are visible. Scores can move as more reviews come in. Sources: Guinness World Records, Dexerto, Notebookcheck, GameSpot, Metacritic. No story spoilers.

short.headline: ONLY 2 GAMES EVER
short.text: Only two games ever scored ninety nine on Metacritic. GTA 6 is the second.
short.text_es: Solo dos juegos han sacado noventa y nueve en Metacritic. GTA 6 es el segundo.

short.headline: THE 99 CLUB
short.text: The other one is Zelda: Ocarina of Time, from nineteen ninety eight.
short.text_es: El otro es Zelda: Ocarina of Time, de mil novecientos noventa y ocho.

short.headline: BEAT EVERY ROCKSTAR GAME
short.text: It also beat every Rockstar game: GTA 4 got ninety eight, GTA 5 and Red Dead 2, ninety seven.
short.text_es: Y superó a todos los de Rockstar: GTA 4 sacó noventa y ocho, GTA 5 y Red Dead 2, noventa y siete.
